meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapka main goal **dark spots + dull skin** hai, to India mein sabse practical choice usually **stable 10% Vitamin C serum** hota hai; beginners ke liye yeh safer start hai, aur Indian skin ke liye brightness aur pigmentation dono target karta hai.[3]

**Best picks by use case:**

- **Beginner / sensitive skin:** **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — source ke mutabik yeh Indian skin ke liye designed hai, dullness aur pigmentation dono ko target karta hai, aur 10% strength beginners ke liye suitable mani gayi hai.[12][3]
- **Stubborn dark spots:** **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** — agar aapke spots zyada visible hain aur skin Vitamin C tolerate kar leti hai, to higher strength option useful ho sakta hai.[3]
- **Budget + popular mainstream option:** **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** — brand ke according yeh dark spots ki visibility kam karne aur dullness ko reduce karne ka claim karta hai.[11]
- **Higher-potency option:** **Foxtale Vitamin C Serum** — 15% L-Ascorbic Acid ke saath pigmentation fade karne ka focus dikhata hai.[13]
- **Affordable general option:** **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** — user discussions aur marketplace listings mein ye common recommendation hai, especially brightening ke liye.[16][17]

**Meri simple recommendation:**
- Agar aap **pehli baar Vitamin C** le rahe ho: **Pilgrim 10%** ya **Minimalist 10%**
- Agar aapko **acne marks / stubborn pigmentation** hai aur skin tolerant hai: **Pilgrim 15%** ya **Foxtale 15%**
- Agar aap **budget** mein rehna chahte ho: **Garnier** ya **Minimalist**[11][16]

**Kaise use karein:**
- Subah 1 serum choose karke lagayein, aur **sunscreen** zaroor use karein; source ke mutabik Vitamin C ka best effect sunscreen ke saath aata hai.[3]
- Agar skin sensitive ho, to pehle **alternate days** se start karein.[3]

Agar aap chaho, main aapke **skin type** ke hisaab se 3 exact options shortlist kar sakta hoon:
- oily skin
- dry skin
- sensitive skin
